resources.string: This model uses CPU. NPU requires a LiteRT-LM model compiled for the device’s Google Tensor chip.
NPU requires a LiteRT-LM model compiled for Google Tensor G5 or G6.
Choose a LiteRT-LM model compiled for this device’s Google Tensor chip. NPU requires Tensor G5 or G6.
The Google Tensor NPU runtime is unavailable on this installation.

Import local models supported by LiteRT-LM or llama.cpp. Available image and audio actions depend on the model. For multimodal GGUF, add the matching mmproj file and select it for the language model. GPU initialization falls back to CPU if unavailable. GGUF GPU execution requires Vulkan 1.2 or later. With GPU selected, LiteRT-LM audio encoding uses CPU.\n\nNPU requires a LiteRT-LM model compiled for the device’s Google Tensor G5 or G6. Keep the original model filename when importing, as some files identify the target chip in their name. Model compatibility and memory requirements depend on the model and device.
Load an audio-capable AI model first.
